text: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Sydney. Which public liability lawyers are best?

sections.text:
You may have a public-liability claim, but a fall alone is not enough—you generally need to show that the shopping centre or another responsible party failed to take reasonable care and that this caused your injury.[5] In Sydney, reputable firms to compare include:

- **Turner Freeman** — established personal-injury practice with a Sydney public-liability team.[2]
- **Slater and Gordon** — handles shopping-centre and supermarket slip-and-fall claims.[8][10]
- **Brydens Lawyers** — specifically advises on slip, trip and fall claims in NSW.[1]
- **Law Partners** — public-liability and supermarket-injury practice with a Sydney office.[6][9]
- **Garling & Co** — handles claims involving shopping centres, businesses and other public premises.[5]
- **LHD Lawyers** — Sydney public-liability practice.[7]
- **Marshall Gibson** — focuses on Sydney slip-and-fall compensation claims.[3]

“Best” depends on the evidence, injury severity, fee arrangement and the lawyer’s experience with occupier-liability disputes. Speak with **2–3 firms**, ask whether the initial consultation is free, and confirm the **total costs**, including whether “no win, no fee” still leaves you liable for disbursements or adverse costs.

## Do this now

- Obtain medical attention and keep all medical records and receipts.
- Report the incident to centre management in writing and request the incident report.
- Photograph the hazard, your footwear, surrounding area and any visible injury.
- Record the exact time, location and circumstances; obtain witness details and preserve CCTV quickly.
- Do not give a detailed recorded statement or sign a settlement/release before getting legal advice.
- Contact a NSW personal-injury solicitor promptly: NSW claims commonly have a **three-year limitation period**, though exceptions and earlier procedural requirements can apply.[1][4][8]

When calling, ask specifically: “Have you handled shopping-centre slip-and-fall claims involving CCTV, cleaning records and occupier negligence in NSW?”
